title: Boy Band
style: pop, synth-driven with a playful bassline and shimmering pads
lyrics:
[Verse]
Baby girl with the starry eyes
Stealing hearts like a sweet surprise
She’s got the world in her tiny hands
Spinning dreams like carousel bands

[Prechorus]
She laughs
The room ignites
Her glow
A thousand lights

[Chorus]
Daddy's girl
She's a firefly
Lighting up the midnight sky
Daddy's girl
She's my whole world
Dancing free
My baby girl

[Verse 2]
She paints the air with giggles and glow
Every step
A story to show
Her smile’s a song
Her hug’s a shield
A treasure chest no one can steal

[Chorus]
Daddy's girl
She's a firefly
Lighting up the midnight sky
Daddy's girl
She's my whole world
Dancing free
My baby girl

[Bridge]
Every tear
Every cheer
I’ll be right here
Year by year
Through the storms
Through the swirl
Forever my baby
My Daddy’s girl
